question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
WITH categorized AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 'No item line'
      WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line'
      WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1 THEN 'More than one item line'
      ELSE 'Unknown item-line count'
    END AS line_category,
    ITEM_QUANTITY
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
  WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
), category_summary AS (
  SELECT
    line_category,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN line_category IN ('One item line', 'More than one item line') THEN ITEM_QUANTITY END) AS avg_ordered_units_per_order
  FROM categorized
  GROUP BY line_category
)
SELECT
  line_category,
  order_count,
  order_count / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_2025_orders,
  avg_ordered_units_per_order
FROM category_summary
ORDER BY CASE line_category WHEN 'No item line' THEN 1 WHEN 'One item line' THEN 2 WHEN 'More than one item line' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;

action.answer: For 2025 recorded orders, 70.005700% had more than one item line (3,052,089 orders). Average ordered units per order were 3.484769 for multi-line orders and 1.219753 for one-line orders (1,307,684 orders). No orders with zero item lines appeared in the query results; the results list 4,359,773 orders total across the one-line and multi-line categories.
